glen.alt: Layered tan bedrock beside Curiosity in Glen Torridon.
glen.caption: Layered bedrock photographed during the Glen Torridon exploration campaign.

ridge.alt: Wide panorama of stratified rocks on the lower Vera Rubin Ridge.

limitations: Ground-level browse photograph, not a georeferenced map or verified feature coordinate.

geometry_audit.result: PDS PLACES v42.0 explicitly describes planetocentric/east rover localizations. These are observer positions, not coordinates of photographed geological features. Not used as target coordinates.
